I replied to Dana in the #north-team thread: the ticket for the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **IT ticket #4092**.

Ilse said this in #north-random on Oct 13. I checked that Dana is a member of that channel before reading it, and everyone in #north-team is in #north-random too, so posting the answer there was fine. In the same reply I passed on Ilse's warning not to unplug the power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.
